decision.observed_event: You come away with a handful of the table coins. That is the line they will not let go: chairs scrape back and blades come out. Roll initiative.

appraisal.label: frustration
appraisal.cause: The rogue steals from the pot.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren steals coins from the pot.
improv_read.connection: Theft is the line the crew will fight over.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lets the theft land, then starts the fight fast.

public_brief.objective: Get the stolen coins back by force.
public_brief.tactic: Turn on her with the whole crew and order them to take the coins.
public_brief.visible_cue: Blades come out of sleeves and boots all around the table.
public_brief.reply_to: While they're gaping, I scoop a handful of coins from the pot and pocket them. 'Toll paid.'
public_brief.kit_focus: Show the quick theft and the table erupting with blades, then call initiative.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, dry humor: the dealer throws her quip back as a threat

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Her hand dips into the pot and comes away full, and the coins vanish into her coat before anyone has closed his mouth. Then the spell breaks. Chairs scrape back all around the table and blades come out of sleeves and boots, short and ugly and very real.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Toll paid? Oh, it will be paid, little thief, in full and with interest. Take the gold back out of her coat, my children, and take whatever else you find in there with it. Nobody steals from this table!
